Plex runs as a Docker container on atlas, so it needs atlas, and it reads its library from tank/media and keeps appdata on tank/appdata, so it needs the tank pool as well.

If titan is off, the Ollama endpoint on it is unavailable, so the wiki search service cannot embed new wiki pages, though keyword search still works. Titan is the only lab host listed as taking down the Ollama endpoint.
The nightly rclone backup runs on atlas at 06:00 and reads the tank snapshot from 05:45, so it needs tank and needs gate for internet access to upload to offsite-crypt.
The hermes VM runs on atlas and stops when atlas stops, and it cannot boot without tank, since its vdisk is on tank/domains.

Syncing of tank/notes to pebble stops, because Syncthing runs as a container on atlas and needs tank, which exists only while atlas runs; Syncthing to pebble also runs only over Tailscale, which is an Unraid plugin on atlas.

gate is the lab's only route to the internet, so with it down the nightly rclone backup, Unraid email notifications, outside access to Caddy-fronted Plex and wiki search (port 443 forwarding), Tailscale remote access, and aria's network features (its address comes from gate's DHCP) lose function.

The wiki search service (qmd) needs hermes directly, since hermes hosts it and the wiki repo. Indirectly it needs atlas, tank (hermes's vdisk is on tank/domains) and apc-1 via atlas. Keyword search still works without titan; titan's Ollama is only needed for embeddings.

With atlas down, the hermes VM and the tank pool stop too. Services that stop: Plex, the Caddy reverse proxy, Syncthing, Tailscale remote access (atlas is the exit node), the nightly rclone backup, Unraid notifications, and the wiki search service on hermes.

If tank became unavailable while atlas kept running, Plex (media and appdata), Syncthing (tank/notes), and the nightly rclone backup (reads the tank snapshot) would stop directly. Through hermes, whose vdisk is on tank/domains and which cannot boot without tank, the wiki search service would stop; Caddy would then fail to front Plex and wiki search.

If hermes is down, the wiki search service (qmd) stops, and its index goes stale because the nightly rebuild timer runs on hermes. The wiki repo at /srv/wiki is unavailable, and pebble loses access to hermes. Caddy's wiki search route also fails.
